<!-- pr-reviewer: 028a0ad0ed6711e39fc584d55be8a987906a81c5 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The parser, tool validation, recipe storage, and machine checks passed the local tests. Existing operation kinds cannot use the new nozzle. A user post must declare waterjet support.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:720` — Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. This change adds a nozzle choice, kerf controls, recipe fields, and a machine choice. The body states that no screenshots were made. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body. Do not add images to this PR branch.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_cutting_rows.rs:72` — Add structural UI tests for the new recipe controls. The new tests check data conversion and undo, but they do not render these controls. The UI rules require structural assertions for UI changes. Check the thickness, kerf, delay, and pierce-method controls, the absence of spindle RPM, and the Apply state for invalid and valid recipes. Use the structural test harness; do not change snapshot PNGs.

Local results:

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `cda3d58965843c30c6c70d59c06ac27c4dcda8b0` returned `Already up to date.` No conflict occurred.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; four steps, zero failures, 14.5 minutes.
- Tools: 86 passed. Post: 150 passed. App: 2,276 passed, 9 existing ignored. UI: 928 passed, 7 existing ignored.
- The UI step ran from `crates/ui`. Its library suite passed: 816 tests, 6 existing ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- No GitHub runner was used.

This was a safety-tier review. I repeated two mutations from the PR:

- `tool-rpm`: disabled the nozzle RPM refusal. `waterjet_nozzle_requires_zero_rpm_and_positive_finite_kerf` failed at runtime at `crates/tools/tests/waterjet.rs:33`. After restoration, it passed.
- `recipe-thickness`: removed thickness from the dimension checks. `waterjet_recipe_rejects_bad_dimensions_and_delays_by_name` failed at runtime at `crates/tools/tests/waterjet.rs:59`. After restoration, it passed.

Both mutations compiled. Both failed with `called Option::unwrap() on a None value` because the expected refusal was absent. Neither compile failure was counted as a test result. All source files were restored, and the worktree was clean.

No NC/CL golden or snapshot PNG changed. No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed. No physical cutting was tested. This change adds no concrete waterjet operation or built-in waterjet post.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed both findings from the latest review.

1. The PR body now links six before/after UI renders. They cover nozzle and machine choices and expanded invalid/valid recipes. The PNGs live only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `2d4e8ca80b70aa0adb77e545c60f89a583dbaf8e`. All six links returned HTTP 200 and matched the inspected renders.
2. Added structural tests `waterjet_recipe_controls_render_without_spindle_rpm` and `waterjet_recipe_apply_refuses_invalid_and_accepts_valid_recipe`. They pin thickness, kerf, all timing controls, pierce-method selection, no spindle RPM, and invalid/valid Apply states. Waterjet Apply now waits for the existing recipe validation and shows its refusal in the disabled tooltip. The valid Apply test also checks command persistence.

Three mutations compiled and failed at runtime: removing recipe controls, showing recipe RPM, and reverting Apply to its original unguarded button. Each passed after restoration.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: four steps, zero failures. Clippy passed for app, post, tools, and UI with all targets and warnings denied. No snapshot PNG or process file changed.

New head: `c37d083c84b1fd1eb9cccfe696317dafc0b3690c`.
Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c37d083c84b1fd1eb9cccfe696317dafc0b3690c -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Both findings from the previous review are resolved.

- I downloaded and inspected all six linked UI images. They show the tool and machine choices before and after the change, and the invalid and valid recipe states. The images are linked from the fork's image branch. They are not in this PR.
- Both new structural tests passed: `waterjet_recipe_controls_render_without_spindle_rpm` and `waterjet_recipe_apply_refuses_invalid_and_accepts_valid_recipe`. They check the recipe fields, pierce method, absence of spindle RPM, Apply state, and saved data.
- The machine and tool checks reject invalid values by name. Existing operations cannot use the nozzle. A user post must declare waterjet support.

Local results:

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `cda3d58965843c30c6c70d59c06ac27c4dcda8b0` returned `Already up to date.` GitHub reports `MERGEABLE` for this head.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; four steps, zero failures, 14.8 minutes.
- Tools: 86 passed. Post: 150 passed. App: 2,276 passed, 9 existing ignored. UI: 930 passed, 7 existing ignored. The UI step ran from `crates/ui` and included the library tests.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The first gate session ended with signal 15 during the app build. Its child continued. The completed retry above is the gate result used for this review. Both app runs finished before the mutation checks.
- No GitHub runner was used.

This was a safety-tier review. I repeated these two mutations locally:

1. `tool-rpm`: disabled the nozzle RPM refusal. `waterjet_nozzle_requires_zero_rpm_and_positive_finite_kerf` failed at runtime at `crates/tools/tests/waterjet.rs:33`. After source restoration, the test passed.
2. `recipe-thickness`: removed thickness from the dimension checks. `waterjet_recipe_rejects_bad_dimensions_and_delays_by_name` failed at runtime at `crates/tools/tests/waterjet.rs:59`. After source restoration, the test passed.

Both mutations compiled. Both tests failed with this message because the expected refusal was absent:

```text
called `Option::unwrap()` on a `None` value
```

All temporary source edits were restored. The worktree was clean after the checks.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- No NC/CL golden or snapshot PNG changed. There were no moved goldens to compare.
- No dependency, build script, workflow, or process file changed.
- Some existing large modules grew by a few lines. This is not a blocking finding.
- No physical cutting was tested. This change adds no concrete waterjet operation or built-in waterjet post.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
